items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 106:1
items.html: (To the question) For at the time that they are in the Hall of Aba and Ima, namely before the shofar blast, when ZA is included there in Aba, and the Nukva in Ima, it is discerned that the Nukva takes there the Gevurot by means of Ima herself, not through ZA, for she is included in Ima and takes the Mochin from her, just as ZA is included in Aba and takes the Mochin from him. However, this reception from Ima does not suffice for the Nukva, because she is her higher upper one; therefore she needs to return and receive them by means of ZA himself, and this comes to her after the shofar blast, during the Ten Days of Repentance. And it is found that only on the first day, before the shofar blast, the Nukva receives by means of Ima; but after the shofar blast of the first day, ZA has already come to his place, and she takes them by means of ZA alone. However, remember that also these Mochin that she takes by means of ZA, during the Ten Days of Repentance, are also called from Ima, not through ZA: for although she takes them by means of ZA, nevertheless the Mochin themselves are attributed to Ima, because they come from the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, which are male MAN. And only the Mochin of face to face are discerned as taken by means of ZA, to indicate that they come from the coupling made in the head of ZA, and not from the coupling of the Aba and Ima of the Mazal. (Item 128).
